title: Process settlement reporting
responsibility: Explains which descendants were delegated, stopped or left running and which outcomes count against a check.

inputs.name: unknownSettlement.why
inputs.description: Reason cleanup could not establish what remains.

inputs.name: settlementReport.asked
inputs.description: Judged processes asked to end during the final settling step.

inputs.name: settlementReport.last
inputs.description: Judged processes present at the final observation.

inputs.name: settlementReport.signalled
inputs.description: Optional predicate identifying every process signalled during cleanup; defaults to membership in asked.

outputs.name: unknownSettlement
outputs.description: Unknown settlement with no asserted survivors, zero stopped/resisted, unknown true and a report explaining that the check fails.

outputs.name: settlementReport
outputs.description: Settlement counting asked-but-absent processes as stopped and final nondelegated processes as running; survivors includes both because either counts against the command. Reports delegated, signalled-running, untouched-running and stopped outcomes.
